Name: WD-40 for chest and refrigerator
Author: 4KMong
Description:
I made this because I didn't like those annoying high frequency sounds when opening and closing chests or refrigerators.

I think it's pretty annoying when you open and close multiple chests multiple times
if you don't use AUTO STACKING MODS to organize them,
so I tried to make a lubricated, smooth sound here, like you put WD-40 on it.

I don't know much about modding (I only wrote HTML briefly when I was a teenager),
but I based it on the STV wiki's modding guide (https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio)
and a vague number of other guy's mods.

I used sounds that were either out of copyright or released under CC BY,
and I included the sound sources as comments in the content.json.
and here below :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DmULkNpU0Zk
https://gongu.copyright.or.kr/gongu/wrt/wrt/view.do?wrtSn=13253083&menuNo=200020


If some patch breaks this mod, I don't have the ability to fix it anymore,
so I'm hoping that people who like these sounds will maintain it.

I don't claim any ownership or exclusivity on this, so I hope it will be a reference for others like me.
This mod can be developed, integrated, modified, and distributed by anyone in a non-commercial manner,
but you must credit the source of this original mod (due to sound source copyright issues that require clear attribution).


********* Caution *********

The sounds for the following three sound asset IDs have been replaced:

openChest
doorCreak
doorCreakReverse

Be careful if other actions or cutscenes play sounds that use these IDs.
Then it can break the immersion.
but I think you seem to be opening chests much more often than watching cutscenes.

I don't want to do much with it since I don't have any further skills.
So This will be the first and last version of this mod.

****************************

Thank you.

Manifest.Name: WD for Chest Sound
Manifest.Description: This mode replaces the original Chest opening sound with a sound without rusty sound.
